gaps.title: Temperature monitoring described generically, no specifics on alerting or compliance automation
gaps.detail: CWT's own description of its cold chain tech stops at 'temperature monitoring and tracking system' alongside separate WMS and iSCM platforms -- no mention of real-time deviation alerts, alert response time, or automated compliance report generation tied to the facility's six certifications. For a site explicitly built and certified to this many standards, that's a real gap between what's certified and what's demonstrably automated.
gaps.based_on: The facility uses a front-end iSCM platform linked to customer ERP systems, a WMS for cargo movements, and a temperature monitoring and tracking system, though no specifics on deviation-alert speed or automated compliance reporting are given.

gaps.title: Multiple parallel compliance regimes in one facility, no stated unified audit trail
gaps.detail: The Singapore hub runs separate Halal and non-Halal storage, hosts an on-site AVA (food safety authority) inspection room, and holds six ISO/HACCP certifications simultaneously. Each is typically documented and audited separately -- a single automated deviation and compliance record spanning all of them would replace several parallel manual trails with one.
gaps.based_on: The facility holds six separate certifications -- ISO9001, ISO14001, ISO22000, ISO22339, ISO45000, and HACCP -- and maintains separate storage for Halal and non-Halal products alongside an on-site AVA Inspection Room.

pitch.angle: CWT's Singapore hub is already built to a high bar -- 750,000 sq ft, six ISO/HACCP certifications, a dedicated government AVA inspection room, and separate Halal and non-Halal storage all under one roof. That's also exactly the kind of facility where a generic 'temperature monitoring and tracking system' needs to prove itself six different ways to six different auditors. GND's ThinxFresh turns that generic claim into one real-time, auto-generated compliance record that satisfies every certification at once, instead of assembling separate evidence for each.
pitch.opener: Running Halal and non-Halal storage plus an AVA inspection room under six ISO/HACCP certifications in one facility -- how many separate audit trails does your team currently maintain for that?
